summary: Adds get/set_antialiased storage and accessors to Text, but the diff never wires self._antialiased into the drawing path (e.g. via the GraphicsContext), so the setter has no effect on actual rendering and the issue's core requirement is unmet.

issues.description: draw() is not updated to pass self._antialiased to the renderer/GraphicsContext (e.g. gc.set_antialiased), so set_antialiased() changes state that is never consulted during rendering — the per-artist antialiasing control the issue asks for is not actually applied.

_reset_visual_defaults (called by cla()/clear() paths) is not shown as updated to (re)initialize _antialiased, so cleared Text objects may retain a stale antialiased value inconsistent with other reset visual attributes.
